scope_notes: Only public commands and SDK geometry/frame outputs were inspected in empty owned documents at idle on private Xvfb.

Independent public CPlane Object witnesses predict all four source point outputs. SDK TryGetPlane distinguishes nonplanar curves and warped surfaces; their actual ScaleByPlane transformations are retained.
Point targets retain active construction-plane axes, distinguished from world X/Y by four tilted-CPlane cases.

Eight whole-mesh SelID targets are rejected. A public SelID completion requests Escape in the owned window after macro Cancel returns to the origin getter; native EndCommand and driver receipt guard completeness.
56 accepted targets have complete/incremental application replays; eight rejected targets have incremental pick/cancel replays plus atomic complete-command rejection checks.
Other curve families, trimmed/multiple-face B-reps, mesh face picking, Rigid groups, previews, extreme coordinates, speed and full parity remain unverified.
